scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:hosting && npm run deploy:firestore
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:client && firebase deploy --only hosting:theme-kitchen-sink
scripts.deploy:hosting:preview: npm run build:client && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview --expires 7d --only theme-kitchen-sink
scripts.deploy:apphosting: npm run build:server && firebase deploy --only apphosting
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy && npm run deploy:apphosting
scripts.firebase:setup:hosting: firebase hosting:sites:get theme-kitchen-sink --project theme-kitchen-sink-project 2>/dev/null || firebase hosting:sites:create theme-kitchen-sink --project theme-kitchen-sink-project
scripts.firebase:setup:apphosting: firebase apphosting:backends:get theme-kitchen-sink-backend --project theme-kitchen-sink-project 2>/dev/null || firebase apphosting:backends:create --backend theme-kitchen-sink-backend --project theme-kitchen-sink-project --primary-region us-central1 --root-dir . --non-interactive
scripts.firebase:setup:firestore: firebase firestore:databases:get theme-kitchen-sink --project theme-kitchen-sink-project 2>/dev/null || firebase firestore:databases:create theme-kitchen-sink --location nam5 --project theme-kitchen-sink-project
scripts.firebase:setup: npm run firebase:setup:firestore && npm run firebase:setup:hosting && npm run firebase:setup:apphosting
scripts.deploy:setup: npm run firebase:use && npm run firebase:setup
